alice.reason: CERN-LHC-ALICE is the ALICE heavy-ion experiment at the LHC; the laboratory and research purpose agree.

belle-ii.reason: KEK-BF-BELLE-II identifies Belle-II at SuperKEKB, distinct from the earlier Belle record 1108579.

supercdms.reason: The local record is at SNOLAB. Select SuperCDMS-SNOLAB rather than the earlier SuperCDMS-Soudan record 1298909.

pico.reason: This is the SNOLAB dark-matter programme. NASA-PICO 1685522 is a space-mission proposal and is a different project.

alpha.reason: Select CERN-ALPHA at the Antiproton Decelerator, studying antihydrogen. ALPHA 2644467 is an axion plasma haloscope.

ace.reason: The local record concerns CERN antiproton research. Select CERN-ACE (AD-4), not the Advanced Composition Explorer spacecraft (1110552).

na62.reason: CERN-NA-062 has collaboration NA62 and a rare charged-kaon decay programme at the SPS, matching the local experiment.

na61.reason: CERN-NA-061 is the SPS Heavy Ion and Neutrino Experiment, with collaboration NA61/SHINE.

argoneut.reason: FNAL-T-0962 is ArgoNeuT, the liquid-argon TPC exposed to the NuMI beam; it is distinct from LArIAT.

mu2e.reason: FNAL-E-0973 is the Mu2e muon-to-electron conversion experiment at Fermilab.

sno.reason: SNO identifies the heavy-water solar-neutrino experiment, not its scintillator successor SNO+.

sno-plus.reason: SNO+ identifies the scintillator successor to SNO. Shared detector infrastructure does not make the two records identical.

homestake.reason: Select HOMESTAKE-CHLORINE for the historical radiochemical solar-neutrino experiment, not HOMESTAKE-IODINE (1108629). Source dates remain unmerged into the reviewed history.

bnl-e598.reason: BNL-E-0598 is titled The Discovery of the J Particle and uses Brookhaven AGS; this is the local J-particle discovery experiment.

e288.reason: FNAL-E-0288 is the Fermilab dilepton-production experiment associated with the upsilon discovery.

tasso.reason: DESY-PETRA-TASSO identifies the TASSO detector at PETRA in the gluon discovery history.

jade.reason: DESY-PETRA-JADE identifies the JADE detector at PETRA, one of the four experiments in the gluon history.

mark-j.reason: DESY-PETRA-MARK-J identifies Mark J at PETRA, distinct from Mark I at SLAC.

pluto.reason: The local gluon-history entry refers to PLUTO at PETRA. Select DESY-PETRA-PLUTO, not the earlier DORIS configuration or the later PLUTO-2 two-photon study.

l3.reason: CERN-LEP-L3 is the L3 experiment at LEP. Its two-character name was intentionally excluded from automatic name matching.
